judge.prompt: Two attempts, a and b, at the same fix were made on private copies of this repository. Each one's status, the output of the visible check, and its patch follow. Both passed the visible check. Choose the one to apply. First line: exactly one letter, a or b. Then your reasons. Prefer the change that fixes the underlying bug in general rather than only the checked case, and reject a patch that edits tests.

cost_model._calibration: 7 runs, 2026-10-13 (validation/calibration.json): Claude attempts $0.029-0.108 (mean $0.058), Codex $0.050-0.086 (mean $0.062), judge ~$0.01, at most $0.0037 per agent-second; no first attempt failed its gate. The per-attempt figures below are twice the observed means and the gate-failure rate is kept pessimistic, for harder tasks than the 7 sampled.
